classification: Post-processing of existing v3 combat measurements; no new combat or Unity execution
method: Three reward formulas only. w=completedWave, floor(4+0.25*w^exponent), zero if w=0. Rate=reward*60/(measured seconds+3). Seeds/builds/weapons/meta and battle outcomes unchanged.
limitations: Reuses identical seed across nine configurations; 90 rows are not independent samples.
Pearson correlation is descriptive across this pooled sample, not causal or inferential.
No save overhead, player interaction time, meta progression over multiple runs, tiers, or hypothetical tier multipliers.
Manual means no purchases, not player-controlled optimized play.
Floor rounding and fixed reward offset materially affect short runs.
